title: The Debate's side commands as Inputs, and the read-only guards on the Review and the audit
description:
Per the map tickets 'Apps per Stage' (harness-0sx.14, Debate and Review) and 'Delegate skills' (harness-0sx.12, Output mapping: the Debate audit). Research: research/agent-clis (docs/research/agent-clis.md).

The Orchestrator builds each Debate side's full headless read-only command from the App table plus the row's model and effort, and the audit's on side A's App, and passes them to stage-moderate as Inputs (Side A command, Side B command, Audit command). The skill's hard-coded claude -p and codex exec lines go; it runs the command it is given with the brief. claude: claude -p [--model m] [--effort e] with Edit, Write and NotebookEdit disallowed; codex: codex exec --sandbox read-only [-m m] [-c model_reasoning_effort=e]. The skill and the Verdict's notes say side A and side B, not Claude side and GPT side.

Guards: stage-moderate checks git status in the worktree after the audit and after each side; a changed worktree is restored and noted in the Verdict. The Orchestrator records the worktree's HEAD before every Review and checks after it, whatever the App (only codex has a sandbox today; pi and opencode come in Ticket 22): a moved HEAD or a dirty tree is restored to the recorded HEAD, clean, and said on RECENT ('review 1 changed the worktree: restored').

The reasoning behind each decision is on the map's closed tickets: bd show harness-0sx.<n> --json --include-comments. Research notes and prototypes live on local branches: git show research/<name>:docs/research/<file>.md, git show prototype/<name>:<path>. Vocabulary: CONTEXT.md. Decisions: docs/adr/. Rust; crates limited to serde, serde_json, regex, chrono, crossterm, ratatui and ureq, anything else needs a ticket.
acceptance_criteria: Fake world: the Moderator's Inputs carry the three commands for claude and codex rows, with and without a model and effort; the shipped stage-moderate has no claude -p or codex exec line of its own; a fake Review that dirties the worktree or commits is restored through the fake git calls and says so; a clean Review changes nothing.
